Messages.Author: dancingmummy
Messages.Body:
Hi all,

I like to print out errata and ruling sheets, so when I am playing
VTES with my non-computer-owning friends(NCOF's), I have something
more concrete to show them other than my word that the Jyhad Fame
which they just played on their own vampire does not do what they
think it does (don't worry--in non-tournament games we tend to let
people take back actions if they didn't know the card was changed).

Anyway, I discarded my old errata sheet when the new one came out on
July 25 of this year, and I later learned to my dismay that cards that
have been reprinted in later sets (WWEF, Fame, Banishment,
Misdirection, etc.) have been removed from the sheet, presumably under
the assumption that everyone has a pre-constructed deck with an
updated card in it.

My question is this: is there any place where I can find a list of
reprinted text for cards with extant reprinted copies? The following
scenario is annoying and not uncommon:

NCOF: "Antoinette Duchamp [with Praxis Seizure: Frankfurt] Banishes
Arika! Ha ha! Eat that!"

Me: "Actually, Banishment can only be played on a younger vampire."

NCOF: "Read the card, moron! It doesn't say that!"

Me: "[sighs]The card was reprinted in the Followers of Set
pre-constructed deck."

NCOF: "[gasp, sputter, convulse]..."

The WW site does not seem to have such a list. I'll make my own
list if there isn't already one out there, I just don't want to
reinvent the wheel.

thanks in advance,
-dancingmummy
